explanation: PR 21 adds the gated HypoMap views. New root and script files: hypomap-release.json pins the atlas export, scripts/fetch_hypomap.mts (pnpm run fetch:hypomap) verifies and installs it into the git-ignored public/hypomap, and services/hypomap holds the loopback comparison service. vite.config.ts proxies /hypomap-preview-api/ to that service only in offline mode with VITE_HYPOMAP_COEXPRESSION=1. The catalog and AGENTS directory map now list services/, and the README documents the export and why hosted delivery stays off.
